name: YeeDiscounts – Dynamic Pricing & Discounts for WooCommerce
author: add-ons.org

sections.description:
YeeDiscounts – Dynamic Discounts for WooCommerce is the ultimate pricing and discount toolkit for your store. Create simple to complex discount rules to boost sales, including Bulk Discounts (Tiered Pricing), Buy X Get X (BOGO), Buy X Get Y, Cart Discounts, Shipping Discounts, and more.

The plugin is designed to be lightweight, easy to use, and fully compatible with WooCommerce High Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and modern Checkout Blocks.

Pro Version: https://add-ons.org/plugin/yeediscounts-pro/
Document: https://yeeplugin.github.io/YeeDiscounts/index.html

Features

  • Two Application Methods: Choose between Automatic (applied seamlessly at cart/checkout) or Discount Code (customers enter promo code at checkout with virtual coupon bridge).
  • Simple Discounts: Percentage, Fixed Amount, or Fixed Price adjustments per product.
  • Bulk Discounts (Tiered Pricing): Setup quantity-based discounts (e.g., Buy 3-4 get 10% off, Buy 5+ get 20% off). Display tiered pricing tables on product pages.
  • Buy X Get X (BOGO): Classic Buy One Get One Free/Discounted logic. Supports recursive rules (Buy 2 Get 1, Buy 4 Get 2…).
  • Buy X Get Y: Buy specific products/categories, get the same or different products for free or discounted (supports Auto Add, Cheapest in Cart, or Most Expensive in Cart).
  • Cart Discounts: Apply percentage or fixed discounts to the entire cart total. Supports applying as a Coupon or Fee.
  • Bundle / Set Discounts: Fixed price or percentage discount for a bundle of items (e.g., Buy 3 items for $100 or save 15%).
  • Shipping Discounts:
    • Free shipping (100% off): Grant free shipping when qualifying conditions are met.
    • Percentage discount on shipping: Deduct a percentage from the shipping cost (e.g., 50% off shipping).
    • Fixed amount discount on shipping: Deduct a fixed amount from shipping fees (e.g., $5.00 off shipping).
    • Method Targeting: Apply to all shipping methods or specific shipping methods/zones only.
  • Customer Eligibility: Target rules to All Customers, Specific Customer Roles / Segments, or Specific Customer Emails.
  • Usage Limits: Limit total usage count and enforce “Limit to one use per customer” (tracks user ID and billing email).
  • Active Dates Scheduling: Schedule start date/time and optional expiration end date/time.

Advanced Conditions

Target your discounts precisely with a wide range of conditions:

  • Cart Conditions: Subtotal, Item Quantity, Line Item Count, Weight, Applied Coupons, Payment Method.
  • Product Conditions: Specific Products, Categories, Tags, Attributes, SKUs, On-Sale Status.
  • Customer Conditions: User Role, Logged-in Status, Email (specific or wildcard).
  • History Conditions: First Order, Last Order Amount, Total Spent, Number of Previous Orders.
  • Geographic: Shipping/Billing Country, State, City, Zipcode.
  • Date & Time: Date range, Time range, Days of the week.

Frontend Features

  • Discount Bar: Display a progress bar or notification message to encourage customers to meet discount conditions (e.g., “Add $20 more to get 10% off”).
  • Bulk Discount Table: Automatically display tiered pricing tables on product pages.
  • Sale Badges: Custom “On Sale” badges with dynamic labels (e.g., “Save 20%”) or hiding badges unless rules match.
  • Strikeout Prices: Show original vs. discounted prices clearly in Shop, Product, and Cart pages.

Admin & Management

  • Modern Shopify/Coupons Style UI: Two-column layout with real-time sidebar summary preview and quick actions.
  • Dedicated Menu: Integrated under Marketing / Coupons for fast access.
  • Reports: Track detailed performance metrics for each individual rule (orders count, total discount amount, order list).
  • Import/Export: Easily migrate rules between sites via JSON.
  • Order Tracking: Full discount details and rule IDs are saved to order items, fees, and shipping items for reliable analytics.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate YeeDiscounts – Dynamic Discounts for WooCommerce
  3. Go to Marketing > Dynamic Discounts (or WooCommerce > Dynamic Discounts) to create and manage rules.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Feature: Added comprehensive Shipping Discounts (Free shipping 100% off, Percentage discount, and Fixed amount discount on shipping fees).
  • Feature: Added option to target All shipping methods or specific shipping methods/zones.
  • Feature: Automatic shipping cache reset on coupon apply/remove for real-time shipping rate recalculation.
  • Feature: Two Application Methods – Automatic vs. Promo Code with WooCommerce Virtual Coupon bridge.
  • Feature: Customer Eligibility block (All customers, User Roles, Specific customer emails).
  • Feature: Usage limits (Total usage limit & One use per customer tracking).
  • Feature: Active dates with start and end date/time scheduling.
  • Feature: Individual rule report view with quick navigation and order audit table.
  • Enhancement: Redesigned rules table and editor in modern Shopify/Coupons style with live sidebar preview.
  • Enhancement: Added default sample rules covering all 7 discount types (disabled by default).
  • Fix: Resolved block visibility and script handling in rule editor.

1.1.0

  • Fixed: Buy X Get Y – Cheapest in Cart

1.0.3

  • Fix: Setting “Choose how the discount rules should apply”

1.0.2

  • Fix: UI tweaks for admin rule editor.

1.0.1

  • Feature: Added Reports section.
  • Feature: Added Import/Export rules.
  • Feature: Added Order Tracker to save rule details to order items/fees.
  • Enhancement: Refined Buy X Get Y logic (auto-add and sync).
  • Enhancement: Improved handling of Recursive BOGO rules.
  • Fix: UI tweaks for admin rule editor.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
